events.title: Middle School STEM Robotics Summer Bootcamp
events.impact: 45 middle school students taught Onshape CAD, Java basics, and drivetrain kinematics.
events.description: A 5-day hands-on workshop giving underrepresented students their first robotics experience. Students built custom 2-wheel drive bots and competed in a friendly mini-game.

events.title: Mentorship: FLL Team #48911 'The RoboPups'
events.impact: Mentored 8 elementary schoolers 2x per week; team advanced to State Championships.
events.description: Our software and mechanical leads guided rookie students through LEGO Spike Prime block coding, sensory alignment, and their Innovation Project presentation.

events.title: Women in STEM Interactive Demonstration
events.impact: 200+ attendees engaged with robot driver controls and interactive mechanism demos.
events.description: Hosted a booth showcasing female leadership in engineering, autonomous vision pipelines, and CAD modeling tutorials.

events.title: Public Library 3D CAD & 3D Printing Series
events.impact: 32 local teenagers earned Onshape CAD beginner certification.
events.description: A free 4-part evening workshop teaching 3D modeling, parametric design, and slicing for 3D printers.
